# sherpa-data-viz-header

The header strip of a metric or a chart's card. Figma "Data Viz Header" (1456:30467).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-data-viz-header/sherpa-data-viz-header.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-data-viz-header/sherpa-data-viz-header.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-data-viz-header/sherpa-data-viz-header.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-data-viz-header/sherpa-data-viz-header.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-data-viz-header/sherpa-data-viz-header.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-data-viz-header data-heading="Alerts by category" data-description="Last 30 days"></sherpa-data-viz-header>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | a line under it (else the metadata slot) |
| `data-divider` | `none` |  | the rule under it; shown by DEFAULT — "none" hides it (a metric's) |
| `data-heading` | text |  | the title — small, light, in CAPS |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a glyph before the title (else the leading slot) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `leading` | icon | a custom leading icon |
| `metadata` | content | what sits under the title |
| `actions` | control | icon-only controls at the end |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`actions`, `description`, `header`, `icon`, `labels`, `left`, `metadata`, `title`
